scope: Public storefront design observations; seller claims are not independently verified.

claims.claim: Home/garden/workwear hybrid homepage uses garden-bed campaign slides, Planting Essentials/Harvesting Gear/Garden Goods category rails, shoppable lookbook, linen copy, bundle promo, reviews, store locator/contact and newsletter. Mixed apparel and gardening content.

Shop All reports 70 products, facets for Product type, Price, Color, Size and Availability (70 in stock, 0 out), Best selling sort and pagination through page 5. Facet labels mix gardening tools and apparel; controls untouched.

Kennith Pant PDP reached through a visible homepage product link despite the short slug; page shows pickup availability and complementary/related products. Captured AX tree included pickup region and accessory suggestions; full price/variant details were not retained in this checkpoint, so details remain unverified.
Dedicated cart route is empty and recommends Accessories, Jackets & Coats, Bottoms and T-shirts collections.
